fixtures.fact: Andy Burnham was elected Mayor of Greater Manchester in 2017 and was re-elected in 2021 and 2024.
fixtures.answer:
Andy Burnham is a British politician who has served as Prime Minister of the United Kingdom and Leader of the Labour Party since July 2026. He was born on 7 January 1970 in Liverpool, Merseyside, England.

**Political Career:**

He was first elected as a member of parliament (MP) for Leigh in 2001, where he served until 2017. During the Labour governments of Tony Blair and Gordon Brown, he was Chief Secretary to the Treasury from 2007 to 2008, Culture Secretary from 2008 to 2009 and Health Secretary from 2009 to 2010.

After leaving Parliament in 2017, Burnham was first elected as mayor of Greater Manchester in May 2017, then reelected for a second term in May 2021 and a third term in May 2024. He returned to Parliament as the Labour (Co-op) MP for Makerfield, and has been an MP continually since 18 June 2026.
